body: As I step back, my eyes scan the darkened lab, the faint scent of chemicals and an eerie hum vibrating through the air. My mind racing with worst-case scenarios, I notice the open door, and my heart sinks. I feel a creeping sense of unease as I notice a trail of footprints leading out of the lab, one step after another, disappearing into the night. My body tenses, ready to sprint towards the nearest exit, my adrenaline fueled by a mix of fear and instinctual protection.
